metadata.warningKo: 모든 건물·계약·거래는 가상 예시입니다. 실거래·감정평가·대출 또는 세무 자문이 아닙니다.

numericConvention: Every numeric field is a plain finite number with a same-key provenance entry on its containing object. Arrays contain records, never bare numeric coordinates. All generated confidence is low.
refPolicy: A ref means a synthetic draw/default from an unverified reference envelope, not a verified observation. Formula reference ids resolve via referenceDependencies; assumption/formula ids resolve here.

a.area.description: Synthetic land area, uniform integer 100–500 m². Floor coverage is independently 55–72% of land.

a.floors.description: Synthetic 3–8 above-ground floors; basement count is 0 or 1. Two fictional suites per floor.

a.shape.description: Hand-drawn approximate gu outlines and Han river line; not official GIS or a geographic claim.

a.location.description: Seeded coordinate jitter within the central 30% bounding box of the schematic gu, rejection-tested inside. Does not locate the named neighborhood, station or any parcel.

a.walk.description: Illustrative station association and 2–18 minute walking time; no route measured.

a.dom.description: Illustrative days on market 0–540, including closed reference examples.

a.exclusive.description: Explicit building assumption: exclusive leasable area / GFA is sampled at 70–84%. Does not resolve unknown.exclusive_to_gfa_ratio.

a.basement.description: Explicit synthetic B1 rent = 60% of this building upper-floor rent draw. Not a district basement reference; unknown.basement_rent remains UNKNOWN.

a.vacant.description: Synthetic vacant suite selection from reference vacancy envelope, rounded to whole suites; minimum one vacant suite. Realized occupancy is area-weighted, not the reference draw.

a.mgmt.description: Occupied-suite fee = 6–10% of contracted base rent, rounded to KRW 1,000. Vacant suites collect zero. Recovery cost is included in opex.

a.opex.description: Synthetic owner expenses: 17–28% of potential annual rent plus 90% of collected management fees. Five allocations: property-tax budget 35%, insurance 8%, repairs 20%, operations 25%, other 12%. Not real tax/expense evidence; unknown.itemized_owner_opex remains UNKNOWN.

a.lease.description: Fictional dates: lease began 1–30 months before snapshot month, original term 36–60 months. No actual tenant contracts. Vacant start/end are null.

a.capex.description: Fictional historical work from max(construction year, 2018) through 2025, KRW 20–180 million per event. Excluded from recurring NOI.

a.valueup.description: Illustrative intervention budgets/downtime/rent uplift only, not executed work or quotes. Lease-up 10–30m/0 months/0%; remodel 120–450m/3–6 months/8–22%; use change 60–200m/2–4 months/5–15%. No computed IRR or value promise.

a.transaction.description: Entirely fictional comparable transaction date 2024 through snapshot, not a public transaction record.

f.area.description: GFA = landAreaM2 × synthetic floorCoverageRatio × (floorsAbove + floorsBelow); exclusiveAreaM2 = GFA × explicit synthetic exclusiveRatio; unit area = exclusiveArea / suite count.

f.ask.description: Seeded price sampled in intersection [KRW 3bn,15bn], district land-price band × land pyeong, and district GFA-price band × GFA pyeong, rounded to KRW 1m. No actual asking/transaction observation.

f.pyeong.description: areaPyeong = areaM2 × 121 / 400. No rounding before rent calculations.

f.rent.description: Potential monthly base rent = exclusive unit pyeong × floor rent draw, rounded to KRW 1,000; occupied contracted rent equals potential, vacant contracted rent is zero.

f.fee.description: Occupied management fee = monthlyRentKrw × synthetic mgmtRate, rounded to KRW 1,000; vacant fee zero.

f.deposit.description: Refundable deposit liability = contracted monthlyRentKrw × seoul.deposit_to_monthly_rent_months demoDefault. Vacant deposit zero; excluded from NOI.

f.sum.description: Summary aggregates: occupied monthly base rent × 12; potential monthly rent × 12; collected monthly management fee × 12; sum of deposit liabilities; sum of itemized annual opex.

f.occupancy.description: Sum occupied exclusive area / sum all exclusive area. No second vacancy deduction from contracted rent.

f.noi.description: Year-1 static annual NOI = occupied annual base rent + collected annual management fees − itemized owner annual opex. Before debt, income tax, capex; no deposit income.

f.cap.description: capRate = annual NOI / whole-property askingPriceKrw. Not sampled from target cap-rate band.

f.value.description: Illustrative income value low = NOI / district capRate.range.max; high = NOI / district capRate.range.min; rounded to KRW 1m. Reference cap envelope is unverified; not an appraisal.

f.unitprice.description: Same fictional transaction price / corresponding land or GFA area in pyeong (m² × 121 / 400).

f.distance.description: Haversine distance in metres between schematic building and comparable coordinates; Earth radius 6,371,000 m; rounded to nearest metre. Not walking distance.

accountingNotes: Snapshot occupied rent is annualized without further vacancy deductions. Potential rent is separate; physical area vacancy is not revenue loss.
Deposits are refundable liabilities. They reduce funding needs only when inherited and must be settled at exit; never included in NOI.
Management fees are modeled gross with operating recovery expenses in opex. VAT, income/exit taxes, lender underwriting and actual expenses remain unverified.
Historical capex is excluded from recurring NOI. Value-up inputs are unexecuted scenarios; their timing/IRR belongs to the future engine.
Income value bands are unverified cap-envelope illustrations; derived cap rates may lie outside the reference cap envelope.
